title: Unified dark sector and Hubble-tension alleviation in scalar-vector-tensor gravity (Jusufi, Khodahami, Sheykhi, Said, Saridakis)
efc_relevance: Scalar-vector-tensor gravity with matter minimally coupled to a Jordan-frame metric and a massive vector sector interacting with the baryonic current. The conformal scalar coupling produces a late-time enhancement of the effective Hubble constant relevant only at low redshifts, alleviating H_0 tension without affecting early-universe cosmology; the vector behaves as effective pressureless matter via a density-dependent mass, yielding a unified dark-sector. Chameleon-type screening keeps Solar-System constraints satisfied. Positioned as a competing framework to EFC: shares EFC's 'late-time-only mechanism' philosophy but achieves it via an explicit vector field rather than an entropy-flow source term.
ledger_action: Add to External Research Ledger under cluster scalar-tensor-horndeski as a new competing-framework candidate (source_type='framework-seminal' upgrade pending more papers in this line); update framework:Horndeski-Deffayet2011 and framework:Galileon-Nicolis2009 rows with a 'unified dark-sector scalar-vector-tensor' sibling note; cross-reference arXiv:2605.05691 (E(z) reformulation of H_0 tension) since both papers argue for late-time-only signatures; required follow-up in Predictions Ledger: state explicit EFC discriminator from the scalar-vector-tensor late-time enhancement on E(z) at z ≤ 0.3.
